entries.p: Simulation Studio Model Logic source file.
entries.n: GRS uses UTF-8 text. Both native { } blocks and the supported begin <name> event ... end surface compile to the same GRS event model; legacy engine event bindings are retained for existing GRS projects.

entries.p: Connects each declared module to its own physical domain before Run.
entries.n: OHT requires Rail-attached Stations. Conveyor requires Stations on one uniquely connected nonbranching LINE path; curves and ambiguous routes are rejected. AMR requires floor Stations, not overhead Rail Stations. Use the existing Station menu's AMR floor Station action to create Level 0 ground-plane Stations. File names, print text and demo Station prefixes do not select equipment. Cross-module logical Load handoff uses call_transport(target_module, load_id, from_station, to_station).

entries.p: Declares which physical Vehicle runtime owns this GRS model.
entries.s: begin model.vehicle_type.oht event end begin model.vehicle_type.amr event end
entries.n: Declare exactly one marker for a typed model. OHT selects SimulationRuntime on Rail; AMR selects AmrSimulationRuntime in Autonomous Area. Legacy Rail and Auto Simulation runs preserve Fleet Mode. Studio blocks an untyped GRS when the saved Fleet Mode is AMR; declare the intended type explicitly.

entries.p: Defines recurring From-To job releases used by Auto Simulation and Static Analysis.
entries.r: Actual From-To, Static Analysis, Auto Simulation
entries.n: Time Interval is seconds between recurring releases for that row. Static Analysis uses moves/hour = 3600 / Time Interval. Auto Simulation schedules first_due = Time Interval and then previous_due + Time Interval, so the first job is not forced at t=0.

entries.p: Runs newly authored OHT, AMR and Conveyor modules together, including Conveyor-only models.
entries.s: begin model.module event set(module_id, "belt_alpha"); set(runtime_kind, "conveyor"); ... end
entries.r: model.init, request_transport, every_event, Studio Station binding
entries.n: Declare ownership in each source file. Same module_id combines files; different modules keep separate events. Use runtime_kind oht, amr or conveyor. One fleet per OHT/AMR kind; multiple Conveyor modules are supported. Station names must match the current drawing and carrier. Compile applies the entire valid model; any error blocks a new Run. No manifest or saved .grproj is required. Optional set(run_until_seconds, 7200) in model.module overrides Studio Run Until; conflicting module declarations are rejected. Pause/Resume retains the active program; Restart uses edited sources. Existing undeclared single-runtime models retain their own execution path. For newly authored simplified GRS, see Automatic model binding: Studio selects Station/Level ownership from literal transport requests, without requiring a model declaration.

entries.p: Receives actual creation, movement, blocked, exit-ready, downstream-release and completion callbacks from the Conveyor job.
entries.s: begin conveyor.job_created event ... end begin conveyor.job_moved event ... end begin conveyor.blocked event ... end begin conveyor.exit event ... end begin conveyor.released event ... end begin conveyor.job_completed event ... end
entries.r: Studio model modules, every_event, request_transport, call_transport
entries.n: Use request from <entry> to <exit> to enqueue real work. every schedules its first request after the specified interval. lifecycle symbols identify the module, Job, Load and actual microsecond timestamp and remain available after a wait. conveyor.exit is the stop-distance handoff-ready boundary; conveyor.released fires after downstream acceptance. conveyor.job_completed remains the ordinary completion boundary.

entries.p: Selects an OHT or AMR Equipment instance whose embedded GLB is used by the matching runtime renderer.
entries.s: begin model.vehicle_type.oht event end begin model.vehicle_asset.<project_instance_name> event end
entries.r: Vehicle runtime type, Workspace Equipment, Simulation Studio 3D
entries.n: The selector suffix matches Equipment instance_name case-insensitively. With no selector, exactly one instance in the matching category (OHT Vehicle or AMR) is bound automatically. Zero or multiple candidates retain the legacy type-specific renderer and emit GRS_VEHICLE_ASSET_FALLBACK. A missing or wrong-type explicit selector blocks Run. The original static placement is hidden only while that View has matching runtime snapshots.

entries.p: Declares unified GRS logic. Canonical engine events and user-defined callable events use the same declaration kind.
entries.n: Parameters are comma-separated identifiers. __gigaroute.* is reserved.

entries.n: New Studio templates use begin NAME event ... end. The older event NAME { } form and these aliases remain accepted for compatibility.

entries.n: Routine lookup has priority over generic Host action lookup. Parameters are positional.

entries.n: There is no periodic condition polling. Prefer explicit event/resource/order-list coordination for high-volume models.

entries.p: Single GigaRoute movement verb. Station targets move a Vehicle through the existing physical route; an unresolved string target is treated as a Queue name.
entries.n: Station resolution has priority. travel() and move_into() are removed from product GRS.

entries.p: Creates a move ScheduleJob for a Vehicle. A Busy Vehicle keeps it in its own queue until an authoritative Idle boundary.
entries.n: Uses the existing RouteCatalog/SimulationEngine physical movement path; no runtime Dijkstra/A* is added.

entries.p: Claims a Load for a Vehicle and creates a retrieve ScheduleJob.
entries.n: Same-owner claim is idempotent. A different Vehicle cannot claim an already claimed Load.

entries.p: Cancels a live script ScheduleJob handle.
entries.n: If physical movement is already committed, route/pose are not rewound or teleported; the physical Load lifecycle still completes.

entries.p: Writes script-side configuration/custom attribute state for an explicit receiver or current actor.
entries.n: Does not silently replace global Simulation Setup physical constants.

entries.p: Makes an alive uncommitted ScheduleJob current. If the Vehicle is busy, the selection takes priority at the next Idle boundary.
entries.n: Soft preempt only: no active-route deletion, rewind, teleport or forced phase mutation.

entries.p: Acquires a named Resource. If it is at capacity, the current process waits on the Resource's targeted scheduler channel.
entries.n: Literal Resource names share one wake channel. Dynamic targets fall back to a single non-blocking acquisition attempt.

entries.p: Releases a named Resource and wakes eligible waiters.
entries.n: Wake-up is targeted through the Resource scheduler channel; there is no fleet polling.

entries.p: Places the current actor on the currently implemented default OrderList and suspends it until ordered.
entries.n: Current product implementation intentionally uses one implicit default OrderList for this action.

entries.p: Releases pending actors from the default OrderList.
entries.n: Uses targeted scheduler wake-up rather than a periodic scan.

entries.p: Runs once when an applied scripted simulation run starts.
entries.n: Authoritative run-start binding.

entries.p: Runs once for each Vehicle when the scripted run is activated.
entries.n: The current Vehicle actor is available through vehicle.*.

entries.p: Runs at an Idle dispatch-request boundary, including initial activation.
entries.n: The ScheduleJob queue guard executes before ordinary dispatch-request logic.

entries.p: Runs once when a live ScheduleJob becomes a Vehicle's current_schedjob.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT job selection event`. This callback was not removed. Implemented. The event actor is the ScheduleJob handle. Re-setting the same current job does not fire again. preempt() fires only when it actually changes the current job.

entries.p: Runs when the committed physical job has fully completed and the Vehicle reaches the authoritative Idle handoff.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT job finished event`. This callback was not removed. Implemented. This is later than vehicle.setdown: configured Setdown dwell must finish first. The event actor is the completed ScheduleJob handle.

entries.p: Fires when a Vehicle reaches the physical Pickup boundary.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT pickup event`. This callback was not removed. A claimed Load becomes onboard at physical Pickup.

entries.p: Fires when a Vehicle reaches the Setdown arrival boundary.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT setdown event`. This callback was not removed. The Load remains onboard through configured Setdown dwell and unloads at the following Idle handoff.

entries.p: Fires at the first real linear movement in Retrieving/Moving after speed exceeds the meaningful threshold.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT start to move event`. This callback was not removed. The internal 0.001 mm/s wake probe is excluded; the event threshold is >0.01 mm/s.

entries.p: Fires when physical motion speed changes meaningfully, including acceleration/deceleration, Sensor BRAKE/STOP and curve-speed transitions.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT speed change event`. This callback was not removed. First-class physical event. Empty handlers are optimized out of the physical hot path.

entries.p: Fires when a Vehicle that previously moved resumes real movement after stopping.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT resume to drive event`. This callback was not removed. Uses an authoritative physical speed transition.

entries.p: Fires on the first real movement within the final route segment toward the destination.
entries.n: Existing engine callback name, kept for saved-model compatibility. For new OHT GRS use `begin Def_OHT decelerate to destination event`. This callback was not removed. No arbitrary distance polling threshold is used.

entries.p: Fires when a Vehicle physically crosses the named Station control point.
entries.n: Only Stations with non-empty handlers are watched. Repeat visits fire again per route occurrence.

entries.p: Historical subsystem-specific movement verbs are intentionally removed from product GRS.
entries.n: Compiler emits GRS_SURFACE_REMOVED_ACTION and directs users to move_to().

entries.p: Optional read-only acceptance predicate for explicit GRS claim(load, vehicle).
entries.s: begin Work_Accept(vehicle, load, pickup) event ... end
entries.n: Runs synchronously immediately before a new explicit script claim mutates Load/ScheduleJob state. It must return Bool. State writes, waits, clone, RNG, transport/resource mutation and unknown Host actions are rejected before execution. If absent, claim() behavior is unchanged. Native Random/Real dispatch and easy transport do not synthesize a Load just to call this predicate.

entries.p: Models endpoint/WIP capacity with the existing Resource acquire/release and targeted wake path.
entries.r: use, get, reserve, free, resource.capacity, station_occupancy_count
entries.n: Resource capacity is the authoritative capacity in this pattern. Station occupancy/reservation is physical Vehicle occupancy and is intentionally not treated as the same value. Capacity waits use targeted scheduler wake, not polling.

entries.p: These words may exist in parser/action-catalog infrastructure, but the current product EngineScriptHost does not provide executable Simulation Studio semantics for them as statements.
entries.s: terminate / remove / add / delete open / read / write / close schedule / choose (AutoMod statement form)
entries.r: choose, schedule_in, schedule_at, terminate_load, file_read_lines, Action Catalog
entries.n: Issue #30: the function forms choose(list [, mode, ...]), schedule_in(event, seconds) and schedule_at(event, seconds) ARE implemented (OHT) and listed in the callable index. Only the AutoMod-style statement keywords above remain parser-recognized without runtime meaning. Help must follow actual runtime support, not parser recognition alone.

entries.p: Returns from the current user-defined event without a value.
entries.n: A bare return produces null. return(value) preserves the existing return-value behavior.

entries.p: Forks script execution after cloning the selected Load actor.
entries.r: create, Load, Runtime Clone, Event execution model
entries.n: With no EntityHandle argument, clone uses the current actor. With an explicit Load handle, that Load is copied (ownership/location/destination/onboard/custom attributes) and the cloned execution branch continues with the copied Load as actor. This is runtime execution machinery, not a user-facing Process declaration.

entries.n: Aliases resolve to the same current physical/script state; they do not duplicate state.

entries.p: Sets or reads a logical Vehicle zone such as building, floor, or operating area.
entries.r: Path zone, current path zone, Simulation Setup Vehicle Zone
entries.n: Zone is logical metadata. It does not automatically change routing, dispatch, Following, or Sensor behavior. Blank means UNASSIGNED.

entries.r: Vehicle zone, route weight, Workspace Selected Path Zone
entries.n: This changes logical runtime metadata only. It does not change route weight, direction, physical length, or automatically restrict route search. Workspace Selected Path Zone is the authoring source for Path.zone.

entries.p: Reads the rail type attribute of a directed Path ID: its type name and whether the rail belongs to OHT or AGV.
entries.n: The type name is authored in Workspace (select rails and a Vehicle object, right-click Type Name...), by DXF layer AGV_PATH* (rail kind default), or by the model.module type_name field. A Vehicle spawns on the rails whose type name equals its own. Read-only at run time; it does not restrict routing.

entries.p: Declares the rail type name a module's Vehicles spawn on.

entries.n: Supported for runtime_kind oht and agv. vehicle_count Vehicles spawn on rails whose type name is LINE_A (OHT: on that rail's Stations; AGV: on that rail). Without type_name, Workspace Vehicle objects with a Type Name, or the established placement, are used.

entries.n: The value is read-only through these accessors. Use set_path_zone(pathId, zone) or Workspace Path settings to edit Path zone. Off-map Vehicles return an empty string.

entries.p: Defines the Simulation Studio authoring policy: native model logic is event-centered and does not introduce a separate user-facing Process type.
entries.s: begin model.init event ... end begin vehicle.pickup event ... end begin dispatch.request event ... end
entries.r: event, model.init, vehicle.*, dispatch.request, clone, wait
entries.n: Simulation Studio Model Logic accepts native GRS source; historical model source should be translated to GRS before validation.

entries.p: Uses the Real or Random From-To workload selected in Simulation Setup while GRS adds user policy callbacks and model logic.
entries.s: begin model.init event ... end begin vehicle.pickup event ... end begin vehicle.setdown event ... end
entries.r: Simulation Setup, Real From-To, Random From-To, configure_motion, disable_native_job_source
entries.n: This describes the existing single-runtime Studio path without model.module declarations. Real/Random From-To remains active even when configure_motion() is called. Declared Studio modules use their own job_source setting (script by default), independently of Auto Simulation Setup.

entries.p: Explicitly disables native Real/Random From-To release when the GRS model generates its own Load workload.
entries.r: configure_motion, create, spawn_event, file_read_lines, Simulation Setup
entries.n: Call this only when GRS itself owns demand generation. configure_motion() does not change workload ownership. Declared modules with job_source=script disable native generation during preparation and need no explicit disable call. A Native declaration conflicts with explicit script transport or source-disable actions.

entries.p: Turns off the OHT Pickup/Setdown transfer (Slide/Hoist) motion to keep the run light. Travel is unchanged.
entries.n: Call from model.init with no arguments. The Core pickup/setdown stop time is kept, so simulation results do not change; only the Slide/Hoist animation is skipped and the carrier switches between port and gripper at the handoff point. The setting applies to the OHT module that declares it.

entries.p: Turns off the Vehicle-phase color change (Idle/Retrieving/Pickup/Moving/Setdown) so the OHT keeps its original model color.
entries.n: Call from model.init with no arguments. Only the display color changes; travel, pickup/setdown time and simulation results are unchanged. Useful for recording videos where a constant OHT color is easier to follow.

entries.p: Turns off STK Crane motion so the Crane does not move separately.
entries.n: Call from model.init with no arguments, before the first outbound request. Crane X/Z travel, Fork extend/retract and the pickup/deposit hold time all become 0, so each Crane job step completes immediately. Inventory, Port Lane and handoff events still occur in the same order. Rejected once the first outbound has started.

entries.p: Turns off the AMR transfer (load/unload) motion setting.
entries.n: Call from model.init with no arguments. The AMR currently has no transfer motion, so the setting is only stored in the AMR engine; travel and the pickup/setdown stop time are unchanged.

entries.p: Model functions use Pascal_Underscore names; equipment acronyms remain uppercase.
entries.s: call OHT_System_Initialize() call ASRS_Seed_Shelf_FOUP(101) call AMR_System_Initialize() call Conveyor_System_Initialize() call Process_Complete()
entries.r: Runtime Function Index, Native OHT / ASRS Functions, Example Model Functions, Model Functions (current source)
entries.n: Existing camelCase model declarations/calls remain compatible through one unambiguous case/underscore-insensitive alias. Canonical dotted hooks such as model.init, vehicle.pickup_complete, conveyor.blocked and equipment.load_arrived are unchanged. Existing snake_case runtime built-ins keep their implementation names; Help displays the same callable in readable Pascal_Underscore form.

entries.t: Global Init / default OHT AMR Humanoid
entries.p: Create the default OHT, AMR and Humanoid counts directly from one global initialization event.
entries.s: begin model.init event vi_OHT = 10 vi_Humanoid = 3 vi_AMR = 3 end
entries.r: model.init, OHT.init, AMR.init, Humanoid.init, print to log
entries.n: New global-init script has exactly one model.init with three positive integer vi_* values and these three typed events. At Compile the already-placed drawing supplies one OHT rail Level and one AMR floor Level (each with two distinct Stations); scripted Job Source is used with no synthetic traffic. Existing C++ Core creates vi_OHT/vi_AMR vehicles. Three-dimensional default humanoids are created at a floor Station. The typed init events run once at simulation time zero and print to the Studio message log. Other legacy and previously declared auto-bound scripts retain their existing behavior. All five previous helper initializers are NOT required for this opt-in.

entries.p: Run starts OHT 10, AMR 3 and Humanoid 3 and drives Humanoid 1 and 2 back and forth through physical floor Stations.
entries.r: Humanoid.init, humanoid.arrived, humanoid_create, humanoid_walk_to, print to log
entries.n: Opt-in requires two GRS files: model_init.grs with vi_OHT, vi_AMR, vi_Humanoid and OHT.init, AMR.init, Humanoid.init; and humanoid_logic.grs with walk resume/start/arrived at station events. All three Init callbacks must complete across all modules before any regular t=0 event or initial humanoid walk begins. A waiting/failed Init rejects Run before simulation time advances. In model_init.grs the authored spwan Def_Humanoid(1 or 2) to humanoid_1 or humanoid_2 is accepted as compatibility syntax. These compile to native humanoid_create, humanoid_walk_to, humanoid.arrived and a suspended 0.5-second wait. Each physical arrival triggers the next leg, without every-event polling. Humanoid 3 remains idle until explicitly dispatched; Job flows removed from this project are not auto restored. Existing auto-bound and explicitly declared module behavior is unchanged.

entries.p: Studio automatically connects literal GRS From-To Station requests to the Workspace OHT, AMR, AGV or Conveyor Runtime at Compile. No explicit module-binding declaration is required for this form.
entries.s: begin model.init event every 20 sec call supply end begin supply event request from Ceiling_Pick to Ceiling_Drop end
entries.r: model.init, request_transport, every_event, Station binding, Simulation Setup
entries.n: Define real transport events; Studio determines Station carrier and Level once during Compile and keeps the original Runtime, scheduler and FOUP identity. Different Station owners can share one source when event ownership is unambiguous. Unknown/cross-Level Station pairs and multi-owner control flow reject Compile instead of guessing. Dynamic Station expressions and native-only models still require explicit ownership information in existing compatible projects until an internal owner-selection path is available. Existing Simulation Setup supplies fleet count/speed/pickup/setdown defaults. Saved explicit module declarations and older auto configuration files continue loading for compatibility; new GRS code should not author a module-binding event. An optional single model.init may call OHT_Init/AMR_Init/Humanoid_Init/ASRS_Init/Conveyor_Init and those typed routines are dispatched to matching physical runtimes.

entries.p: Keeps original model colors by switching off phase or pose colors for matching OHT, AMR, AGV and Humanoid runtimes in the current Studio session.
entries.r: Studio model modules, oht.color_fixed, amr.color_fixed, humanoid.color_fixed
entries.n: Available in a declared Studio model session. With no argument all matching runtimes are affected, regardless of which module owns the call. One quoted type limits the scope; AMR and AGV are distinct. A missing target or unsupported argument fails with a GRS_COLOR_OFF diagnostic. Motion, Job timing and FOUP ownership are unchanged. Legacy oht.color_fixed / amr.color_fixed / humanoid.color_fixed remain accepted. Auto/legacy undeclared execution is unchanged.

entries.p: Hands a logical Load to the one existing prepared runtime that owns the destination Station route, with no explicit target module name.
entries.r: call_transport, Studio model modules, Station binding
entries.n: Three arguments select a destination only when exactly one non-source runtime validates both Station endpoints. An unknown or ambiguous target is rejected with GRS_TRANSFER_NO_TARGET or GRS_TRANSFER_AMBIGUOUS_TARGET. The previous four-argument call_transport(target_module,load_id,from,to) remains unchanged. Source Setdown and destination capacity, event timing, and Load ownership all use the existing physical transfer protocol; no new polling or Load ID namespace is introduced.

entries.p: Physical Vehicle speed changes.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT speed change event ... end
entries.n: Uses existing engine speed transitions, not polling. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: A stopped Vehicle starts driving again.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT resume to drive event ... end
entries.n: Uses a real resume transition. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: The Vehicle starts actual travel.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT start to move event ... end
entries.n: Ignores the internal near-zero wake probe. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: A physical ScheduleJob reaches its completed handoff.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT job finished event ... end
entries.n: Fires after setdown dwell; actor is the completed ScheduleJob. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: A live ScheduleJob becomes selected.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT job selection event ... end
entries.n: Actor is the selected ScheduleJob; unchanged selection does not re-fire. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: The Vehicle reaches the final prepared travel span.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT decelerate to destination event ... end
entries.n: Fires on actual movement in the final span. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: The Vehicle reaches its pickup or setdown Station.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT arrived at station event ... end
entries.n: Fires once at the arrival boundary before the pickup/setdown event. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: An idle OHT begins its next Job or explicit travel.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT job assigned event ... end
entries.n: 2026-10-17: fires on Idle-to-travel/Pickup transition; actor is the assigned Vehicle. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: The OHT passes a Station on its route.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT passing station event ... end
entries.n: 2026-10-17: fires for each physically crossed Station, excluding departure; no fleet-wide polling. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: The OHT starts a discrete heading change at a corner.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT steer change event ... end
entries.n: 2026-10-17: fires on a meaningful turn even with in-place rotation disabled; continuous arc steering is excluded. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: The OHT starts a new travel leg toward its destination.
entries.s: begin Def_OHT destination change event ... end
entries.n: 2026-10-17: fires at travel-leg start (initial travel or post-pickup delivery), up to twice per Job. The engine uses an internal callback key; write the Def_OHT event header in new GRS models.

entries.p: AMR and AGV (AMR Core Fixed Path) use the same 12 event phrases as Def_OHT: pickup, setdown, speed change, resume to drive, start to move, job finished, job selection, decelerate to destination, arrived at station, job assigned, passing station, destination change.
entries.r: Def_AMR, Def_AGV, AMR, AGV, GRS Events
entries.n: Def_AGV and Def_AMR lower to the same events. steer change is OHT only. Observation is enabled only for events you implement and never changes physics. This AMR / this AGV is the actor Vehicle. passing station radius is max(250 mm, body radius); vehicle.passing_station_name reads the station just passed.

entries.p: Humanoid uses the same 12 event phrases. Job means humanoid_transfer; pickup/setdown fire when humanoid_pick/humanoid_place start.
entries.n: this Humanoid is humanoid_self(); humanoid_event_place() reads the place just passed (within 400 mm) inside passing station. resume to drive occurs only in live walking. steer change is OHT only.

entries.p: Compatibility helper for reading an AutoMod-style indexed List variable.
entries.n: Preferred GRS syntax is ListName(1) / Matrix(1, 2). Indices are 1-based positive integers; rank is inferred automatically. Implementation spelling: array_get().

entries.p: Compatibility helper for writing an AutoMod-style indexed List variable.
entries.n: Preferred GRS syntax is 'set ListName(1) = value'. Element type and rank are inferred from GRS source; no separate Variable declaration is required. Implementation spelling: array_set().

entries.p: Returns a uniform random value in [mean-half_range, mean+half_range].
entries.n: This preserves the imported-model mean/half-range contract; it is not a min/max signature. Implementation spelling: automod_uniform().

entries.p: Selects one candidate from a List. mode: "first" (default) returns the first entity; "random" draws uniformly via the existing automod RNG stream; "min"/"max" pick by numeric attribute (deterministic tie-break: lowest List index wins); "where" returns the first entity whose named attribute equals value.
entries.n: #30 P6: OHT only for now -- weighted_choice/automod_uniform and this whole general call-utility surface are not yet wired into the AMR Host. Returns null when the list is empty or no candidate matches; never guesses at a dependency chain or root cause. Implementation spelling: choose().

entries.p: Keeps the original model colors across matching Studio OHT, AMR, AGV and Humanoid runtimes.
entries.n: Studio declared-model sessions only. With no argument, applies to all matching runtimes; with a type, only to that type. Does not change Jobs, timing or motion. Existing type-specific color_fixed calls remain supported. Implementation spelling: color_off().

entries.p: Turns off the Vehicle-phase color change so the AMR keeps its original model color.
entries.n: Call from model.init. Only the display color changes; travel, pickup/setdown time and results are unchanged. Implementation spelling: amr.color_fixed().

entries.p: Turns off the pose color change so every Humanoid keeps its original model color.
entries.n: Call from model.init. Only the display color changes; motion, timing and results are unchanged. Implementation spelling: humanoid.color_fixed().

entries.p: Returns every OHT Vehicle of this module as a list. `for each v in Def_OHT` lowers to it.
entries.n: Implemented runtime callable. Implementation spelling: oht_vehicle_list().

entries.p: Starts a walk to a Station/defined place without suspending the caller. Returns seconds.
entries.n: Same physical walk as humanoid_walk_to, but the calling GRS process continues; the next leg is driven by humanoid.arrived. Implementation spelling: humanoid_dispatch_async().

entries.p: Registers an initial walk during Humanoid.init. Returns true.
entries.n: Started at t=0 only after every OHT.init, AMR.init and Humanoid.init has completed (global Init barrier). Implementation spelling: humanoid_queue_initial_dispatch().

entries.p: Turns in place to face a place or Station (absolute heading, shortest turn). Returns seconds.
entries.n: Implemented runtime callable. Implementation spelling: humanoid_face().

entries.p: Inside a Def_Humanoid passing station event returns the place name that was just passed (lower case).
entries.n: Implemented runtime callable. Implementation spelling: humanoid_event_place().

entries.p: Returns true once SimulationEngine already owns the physical route for this ScheduleJob.
entries.n: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. #30 P4: source/destination Station, assigned/pickup/setdown/completed timestamps, and cancel state/reason are Not Implemented as ScheduleJob Attributes -- the current ScheduleJob struct does not own that state, and this Issue does not fabricate a sidecar owner for it.

entries.p: Returns UTF-8 byte length of the current Host String.
entries.n: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.
